title: Billing-Error Concession on the Residential Electricity Supply Plan-Change Rate
content:
Pricing rule, Residential Electricity Supply plan changes. A customer whose agreement has carried billing errors receives a concession on the plan-change rate.

**Rule.** The agreement's rebill credit lines and its open billing disputes are counted together; with two or more the multi-error concession of 0.50 cents per kWh applies, with exactly one the single-error concession of 0.25 cents per kWh applies, and with none no concession applies.

**What is counted.** Every rebill credit line on the agreement's bills, whenever posted, plus every billing dispute on the agreement whose status is open. Settled disputes are not open and are not counted.

| Rebill credit lines | Open billing disputes | Items counted | Concession (cents per kWh) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0 | none |
| 1 | 0 | 1 | 0.25 |
| 0 | 1 | 1 | 0.25 |
| 1 | 1 | 2 | 0.50 |
| 3 | 0 | 3 | 0.50 |
